C-LINT-PHASE-HONESTY.Summary: Make current-mode lint honest about phase: stop claiming a C-* change is in progress when that is inferred from approved status alone, keep failing baseline assertion.* issues as errors, and explain the dual possibility on the text lead line. Close the detector's implicit-current gap against current-mode lint of this project root in TargetAssertions MustPassCommand. Rewrite the MustPassCommand doctrine once, as that property, across all ten surfaces. Replacement of the narrower C-PHASE-RULE-PIN charter.
C-LINT-PHASE-HONESTY.Problem:
ngrace lint in default current mode computes that a baseline finding is expected, says so, and then contradicts itself: the text lead line reads "Baseline expectation: 1 expected while a C-* change is in progress" while summary.errors still counts that issue and exit is 1. The lead line is formatTextReport at src/lint/core.ts:780-787. summary.errors is a plain severity count at src/lint/core.ts:255. The evaluation that feeds the count is src/lint/core.ts:519 (assertionMode === "current" && status === "approved") — whether a single write has happened is unknown to it. An approved-but-untouched plan and a half-executed one are indistinguishable.
That inference is the premise AC-BASELINE-LINT-FRAMING (C-REPORT-HONESTY, P0.9) used to keep baseline issues as errors while labelling them expected. The criterion required the issues remain errors — "not deleted, not downgraded to warning or zero" — and stated that a fix which removes or skips baseline evaluation fails. Its derivation (docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/p0-report-honesty-derivation.md Q5 / P0.9) called silencing baseline issues in current mode unacceptable, because it would stop catching real baseline breakage. The severity pin is src/lint/core.test.ts:251.
This spec amends the framing half of AC-BASELINE-LINT-FRAMING and keeps the evaluation half. C-REPORT-HONESTY was correct that reclassification is unsafe while the phase is inferred. This bundle removes the inference rather than trusting it: current mode still evaluates approved baselines and still emits them as errors, so real breakage stays visible; it no longer claims those errors are expected because a C-* is in progress.
Adjacent, and in scope as the other half of the same honesty defect: assertion.phase-incompatible-command matches only an explicit --assertions current on a TargetAssertions MustPassCommand (src/artifact/assertions.ts:262). Default mode is current (src/grace-lint.ts:87-93), so bun run ngrace lint --path . — the form 21 archived plans carry — does not match. F130 named that gap; C-PHASE-RULE-PIN drafted a detector-and-two-skill-files repair. The maintainer widened the charter: make the tool phase-aware and honest, and rewrite the doctrine once across all ten surfaces, as a property, not a list of verbs.
Measured 2026-09-01 at HEAD 3090ded. Cite, do not re-derive. Root lint xmlFilesChecked is 204, Errors 0, Warnings 0. examples/polyglot is 0/0. The other five bare invocations are four --help probes and one ngrace review --path examples/polyglot. Live polyglot C-ADD-KEYBOARD-NAV TargetAssertions MustPassCommand is bun test apps/web/src/components/LedgerTable.example-test.ts and would not newly flag.

Goals.Goal: Amend AC-BASELINE-LINT-FRAMING's text lead line. When current mode reports N>0 semantically-evaluated BaselineAssertions issues, formatTextReport still leads with one line and those issues remain severity error with their existing assertion.Must* (or extraction) codes. The lead line must not contain "expected" or "in progress". Exact operator-facing text, singular N=1: Baseline assertion failures: 1. Current mode cannot tell whether writes have started. If the baseline is still the intended state, this is real breakage. If writes have started, use --assertions target --change C-ID (or --assertions final). Plural N>1 uses "failures: N" and "these are real breakage" with the same remainder. N=0 is unchanged: first line is neo-grace Lint Report and no baseline lead line is emitted. JSON.stringify of the result gains no new top-level key (D13).

Keep current as the default assertion mode at src/grace-lint.ts resolveAssertionMode, the lint command assertions default, and src/lint/core.ts. Do not add a fifth mode and do not add a second flag axis. The four existing modes already express phase; current means the operator is not claiming a selected phase. When current sees baseline failures it explains that the operator may need to claim one.

Keep evaluating approved-plan BaselineAssertions in current mode (src/lint/core.ts:519 evaluateCurrentBaseline). That predicate is evaluation, not an in-progress claim. Skipping it would reverse AC-BASELINE-LINT-FRAMING's evaluation half and hide real baseline breakage. Do not infer writes-started from git dirty, the ledger, or ObservedWriteScope.

Tighten validateAssertionPhase so assertion.phase-incompatible-command fires on a TargetAssertions MustPassCommand whose command text is current-mode lint of this project root, whether --assertions current is explicit or omitted. The detector still earns its place: current-mode lint of this root can exit 0 when baselines still hold after writes, and that green is the wrong kind of target evidence. A self-explanatory failing current-mode run does not catch the silent-green case. Keep the diagnostic on TargetAssertions MustPassCommand only.

Matcher, command text only, after flattening whitespace. A Command is current-mode lint of this project root iff all of: (1) it invokes ngrace lint, bun run ngrace lint, or src/grace.ts lint as a subcommand; (2) it does not contain --help; (3) it contains --assertions current (optional = and quotes) or it contains no --assertions token; (4) it has no --path token, or the --path / --path= value is . or ./. Never read package.json and never resolve bun run <script> into script bodies. Silent on bun run validate:ci, bun run lint, bun run ngrace:lint, ngrace status, ngrace review, ngrace gate, ngrace lint --assertions baseline|target|final, ngrace lint --path examples/polyglot, and ngrace lint --help / ngrace gate --help.

Update the issue message and src/lint/catalog.ts assertion.phase-incompatible-command explanation so both name omitted --assertions as current mode and name this project root. Keep the phrase leaf project evidence in the message; src/grace-lint.test.ts asserts it. Keep the Phase-Incompatible title.

Rewrite the MustPassCommand doctrine once across all ten surfaces as this property, not a list of verbs. Canonical sentence: MustPassCommand contains leaf project evidence such as tests, typecheck, build, format, or package checks. Do not put a current-mode lint of this project root in TargetAssertions. Current mode means the command text contains --assertions current, or it invokes ngrace lint and omits --assertions. The restriction matches command text; it does not resolve bun run <script> through package.json, and it does not apply to --help or to lint of a different project root. Use selected target/final lint externally instead. The ten files: README.md (the paragraph at the MustPassCommand doctrine, currently line 214), examples/cli/README.md (the Current-mode paragraph, currently line 20), skills/ngrace/ngrace-cli/SKILL.md lifecycle_command_contract, skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md preflight phase-incompatible clause, skills/ngrace/ngrace-explainer/references/verification-driven-dev.md (the plan-assertions paragraph, currently line 85), skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md command_phase_rules MustPassCommand bullets, and the four plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ mirrors of those skill files. Constraints.Constraint: Ceremony tier T2 (cross-cutting): lint core banner, assertions detector, catalog copy, four canonical skill files plus packaged mirrors, README.md, and examples/cli/README.md.

This spec amends AC-BASELINE-LINT-FRAMING (C-REPORT-HONESTY / P0.9). It does not silently contradict it. Evaluation of approved baselines in current mode stays. Severity of those assertion.* issues stays error. The lead-line claim that they are expected while a C-* is in progress goes. The original objection — silencing current-mode baseline issues would hide real breakage — is answered by not silencing them.

Binding ruling 2026-09-01: the MustPassCommand restriction governs command text, not what the command transitively runs. bun run validate:ci as a MustPassCommand conforms even though validate:examples member runs ngrace lint against examples/polyglot. AcceptanceCriteria.AC-HONEST-LEAD: Given an active approved plan whose BaselineAssertions include a failing MustNotExist (the C-REPORT-HONESTY fixture shape) and default text lint output, formatTextReport leads with Baseline assertion failures: 1. Current mode cannot tell whether writes have started. If the baseline is still the intended state, this is real breakage. If writes have started, use --assertions target --change C-ID (or --assertions final). The underlying assertion.MustNotExist issue remains severity error. The lead line does not contain "expected" or "in progress". Plural N=2 uses "failures: 2" and "these are real breakage". N=0 still leads with neo-grace Lint Report and emits no baseline lead line. TargetAssertions-only extraction issues still do not produce a lead line alone. Archived plan baselines stay syntax-only and contribute 0 to N. Malformed BaselineAssertions still include extraction issues in N (existing design ruling). Proven in src/lint/core.test.ts, replacing the in-progress wording assertions and keeping the severity pin and the D13 JSON-key pin.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NO-SILENCE: Current mode continues to evaluate BaselineAssertions of every active approved plan. A failing MustNotExist against a file that exists still emits assertion.MustNotExist as an error under default lintGraceProject() (no assertionMode option). A fix that skips that evaluation, deletes the issue, or downgrades it to warning fails this criterion. This is the surviving half of AC-BASELINE-LINT-FRAMING.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CLEAN-NONREGRESSION: On a project with no failing current-mode baseline issues, error count, warning count, issue codes, and JSON top-level keys are unchanged. Live proof: bun run ngrace lint --path . --fail-on warnings is 0/0, bun run ngrace lint --path examples/polyglot --fail-on errors is 0/0, and bun run validate:examples exits 0. Fixture proof: the N=0 case in src/lint/core.test.ts still leads with the title.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-DEFAULT-UNCHANGED: Omitting --assertions still selects current. There is no fifth assertion mode and no additional flag that means phase. resolveAssertionMode still accepts exactly current|baseline|target|final.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-DETECT-CURRENT: assertion.phase-incompatible-command fires on a TargetAssertions MustPassCommand whose Command text is current-mode lint of this project root, in both directions of the flag: explicit --assertions current, and a lint invocation with no --assertions token. Covered invocation forms in fixtures: ngrace lint, bun run ngrace lint, and src/grace.ts lint, each with --path . omitted or set to . or ./. Proven in src/artifact/assertions.test.ts and src/grace-lint.test.ts, including that default lintGraceProject() (no assertionMode option) still reports the issue on an active plan.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SILENT-CONFORMING: assertion.phase-incompatible-command does not fire on TargetAssertions MustPassCommand Command text that is any of: bun run validate:ci; bun run lint; bun run ngrace:lint; ngrace lint --assertions baseline; ngrace lint --assertions target; ngrace lint --assertions final; ngrace lint --path examples/polyglot; ngrace lint --help; ngrace status --path .; ngrace review --path .; ngrace gate --help. Proven by fixtures in src/artifact/assertions.test.ts, not by live artifacts.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ARCHIVE-EXEMPT: An archived plan whose TargetAssertions MustPassCommand is either explicit --assertions current or bun run ngrace lint --path . does not emit assertion.phase-incompatible-command. src/grace-lint.test.ts already covers the explicit-current archived case; add the implicit-current archived case beside it.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NO-TRANSITIVE: The tightened matcher in src/artifact/assertions.ts contains no read of package.json and no script-body lookup. A fixture whose Command text is bun run validate:ci stays silent even if the test process's package.json scripts validate:ci / validate:examples run ngrace lint.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-DIAGNOSTIC-TEXT: The issue message and the catalog explanation for assertion.phase-incompatible-command name omitted --assertions as current mode and name this project root. The message still contains the phrase leaf project evidence. src/grace-lint.test.ts continues to assert that phrase and the Phase-Incompatible title.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-DOCTRINE-TEN: Each of the ten files named in Goals states the property, not a verb list that condemns ngrace status, --help, or lint of a different project root. Canonical and packaged skill bodies for each edited skill are byte-identical. bun run ./scripts/validate-marketplace.ts exits 0.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PIN-SURVIVAL: After the skill and README edits, bun test scripts/skill-contracts.test.ts src/review/core.test.ts src/artifact/grammar.test.ts exits 0. Those tests are not in the forced write surface; the wording change must not make them red.
